name: Construction
blurb: Housebuilding and retrofit plans across Greater Manchester need many more electricians, bricklayers, roofers, quantity surveyors and engineers.

name: Logistics
blurb: Warehouses and haulage firms across GM are short of experienced HGV drivers, and want stronger business development and customer service skills too.

name: Health & Social Care
blurb: Care providers and the NHS across GM need many more healthcare assistants and nurses, plus better take-up of senior care qualifications.

name: Engineering & Manufacturing
blurb: From graphene to precision parts, GM manufacturers need degree-level engineers alongside welders, fitters, technicians and robotics specialists.

name: Digital & Technology
blurb: Manchester's tech and cyber sector needs more cybersecurity, data, cloud and AI specialists, plus a steady stream of IT technicians and developers.

name: Creative & Media
blurb: GM's creative sector, centred on MediaCity Salford and Factory International, wants AI-confident designers, live-event technicians and digital marketers.

name: Hospitality
blurb: Hotels, restaurants and visitor attractions across GM struggle to recruit chefs and to keep good mid-level staff long enough to promote them.

name: Finance & Professional Services
blurb: GM's financial and professional services hub needs more qualified solicitors, chartered accountants, and B2B sales and business development skills.
